posts.text: Willie Colon on Yahya Black: “He’s the cog that’s going to make this thing turn the right way. I understand this is a second-year guy, he’s new to the position. One of the things we were frustrated with his play is he plays too high to be a nose tackle. He’s mountain strong. He has all the rough and tough things you like about a nose tackle. But there’s times when that offensive line starts chipping up and getting to the second level, he gets rolled sometimes because his pads are too high.” #Steelers #NFL
